notes.title: Bloom Joins Steam Next Fest—Demo Out Now!
notes.content: [p]We’re beyond excited to announce that [b]Bloom[/b] is part of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], and our [b]demo is officially LIVE![/b] 🎉[/p][p]For this week only, you can explore the first [b]3 full story chapters[/b], packed with charming characters, engaging puzzles, and a heartfelt journey as Arya and her adorable pup, Bo, set out to restore Earth’s beauty. The demo is available to play on Windows, Mac, and Steam Deck![/p][p][/p][h3]What’s Inside the Demo:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Three Story Chapters:[/b] Immerse yourself in the opening acts of our heartfelt narrative. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Challenging Puzzles:[/b] Engage with puzzles designed to intrigue and delight.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vibrant Visuals:[/b] Explore beautifully hand-painted environments that bring Bloom’s world to life.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3370250/Bloom__a_puzzle_adventure_Demo"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Jump in, play the demo, and let us know what you think on our community page. We can’t wait to hear your thoughts![/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3300090/discussions/3/" style="button"]Demo Feedback[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]If you love the demo, please don’t forget to wishlist Bloom—it helps us immensely and ensures you won’t miss our upcoming launch![/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3300090/Bloom__a_puzzle_adventure/"][/dynamiclink]Thanks for supporting our journey—and enjoy Next Fest![/p]

notes.title: Bloom Got Featured by IGN; Demo Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey, everyone![/h3]

As a small indie team of three working from our bedrooms, seeing our creation highlighted on IGN is beyond our wildest dreams. We've poured our hearts into crafting an experience that is not only fun to play but also comes with a quirky and snackable story that we can't wait for you to experience.

As a small indie team of three working from our bedrooms, we understand how challenging the journey can be. That's why it means the world to us to see our game highlighted on IGN—it's truly a dream come true and a moment we could only hope for. Thank you for being part of this incredible journey with us.

You can watch the video here: 

[previewyoutube=bjbFraqG8_s;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Demo coming soon![/h3]

We’re also excited to share that [b]a demo is coming your way soon! [/b]Get ready to dive into the first three story chapters on [b]PC, Mac, and Steam Deck.[/b] The demo will showcase the story, gameplay, and mechanics. While the level maker isn’t part of this demo, we’re considering a separate test version if you’re eager to try it out.

Thank you for joining us on this incredible journey. Keep an eye out for more updates, and follow us as we continue to bring Bloom to life.
